sentence_stem: When I was a child, I used to
correct_completion: play in the park every afternoon.
full_sentence: When I was a child, I used to play in the park every afternoon.
acceptable_variants: ride my bike around the neighbourhood.
spend hours outside with my friends.

options.text: to play in the park every afternoon.
options.why_wrong: 'Used to' is followed directly by the base verb, so 'to' must not be repeated after it.

options.text: playing in the park every afternoon.
options.why_wrong: After 'used to' the verb must be in the base form, not the -ing form.

options.text: play in the park every afternoon.
I have played in the park every afternoon.
options.why_wrong: 'Used to' is not followed by a present perfect auxiliary; adding 'have' breaks the structure.

grammar_focus: Used to + base verb for past habits and states
explanation: The structure 'used to' is followed by the base form of the verb to describe a past habit that no longer continues. Learners often add an extra word or an -ing form after it, which is incorrect.
translation: Kiedy byłem dzieckiem, zwykłem bawić się w parku każdego popołudnia.
